description: This file defines the class MonkeySourceScript, which is responsible for reading and parsing script files containing sequences of events (such as key presses, touch events, rotations, etc.) for the Android Monkey testing tool. It creates event objects based on script lines and enqueues them for injection into the system, supporting various input and control event types.

classes.name: MonkeySourceScript
classes.description: Implements a MonkeyEventSource that reads a script file to generate system events for testing Android applications.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the script file header by attempting to read and parse it, ensuring the script is correctly formatted and available.

methods.name: setVerbose
methods.description: Sets the verbosity level for logging during script processing.

methods.name: getNextEvent
methods.description: Retrieves the next event from the script, reading more events into the queue if needed, and adjusting timing to simulate real-time injection.
